phase_1.name: Real Cosmetics End-to-End Commerce Product
phase_1.objective: Deliver the full end-to-end commerce system for Real Cosmetics as a stable, branded, production-grade cosmetics marketplace

subphases.name: Shared UI System and Token Baseline

exit_criteria: Real Cosmetics works as a full end-to-end commerce product
Critical storefront, commerce, account, pharmacist/test, admin, and mobile flows are production-ready
Phase 1 can serve as the stable baseline for Phase 2

phase_2.name: SaaS Platform
phase_2.objective: Turn the Phase 1 commerce foundation into a reusable SaaS platform without changing or breaking the Real Cosmetics product
phase_2.core_constraint: Phase 2 must extend the system without changing the business behavior of Phase 1
exit_criteria: SaaS platform capabilities exist without breaking Phase 1
Real Cosmetics continues to run as the baseline tenant/product
Product-specific and platform-specific concerns are clearly separated
Platformization is spec-backed, migration-safe, and operationally coherent
